label: compute-stream copies for tiny bulk transfers
hypothesis: For <=8 tokens, place the tiny H2D directly on the consuming compute stream and skip the redundant first-layer cross-stream wait. Baseline decode profiles show ~5.5/5.8 us CPU H2D submission and ~11/22 us transfer spans at b1/b8. Reduced stream coordination may exceed the lost Q/K overlap for such small transfers.
expected_bottleneck: tiny bulk H2D stream switching and dependency coordination
change: Use compute-stream H2D only for <=8 token bulk calls, preserving copied/consumed events for pinned-host and cross-call buffer safety. Keep separate-copy-stream path for larger bulk calls and pipeline unchanged. Fresh torch gather every call; no A0002/A0003/A0004 changes.

screen.reason_batch16: H2D scheduling change, including unchanged larger-batch control

tradeoffs: Serializes tiny transfer before Q/K kernels, potentially losing more overlap than saved CPU submission time.
Transfer byte count, table precision and buffer capacities unchanged.

implementation_revisions.phase: final candidate freeze before all performance measurement
implementation_revisions.change: Preserve first-call allocation-stream dependency for cross-stream callers; same scheduling hypothesis.
